pages.title: Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 in force

facts.text: Four-way segregation: wet, dry, sanitary, special domestic hazardous

facts.text: Bulk generators: > 100 kg/day waste, > 40,000 litres water use, or > 20,000 sq m area — on-site processing

pages.title: Climate change reshaping disease patterns in India

facts.text: ~40% of districts at high risk from extreme weather
facts.head: Key findings

facts.text: Dengue spreading to non-traditional areas — Shimla, parts of J&K

facts.text: 160 billion labour hours lost in 2021 to extreme heat

facts.text: ⚠ 95% HAPs lack vulnerability assessment; 67% focus only on daytime heat; ₹32,000 crore SDMF underutilised
